build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder instance with config, dictionary, and token embeddings for sequence generation
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass on prev_output_tokens with encoder output for teacher forcing
extract_decoder_features: extract decoder features from prev_output_tokens without projecting to vocabulary size
project_output_layer: project decoder features to vocabulary size using the output embedding matrix
create_future_mask: create a buffered causal future mask tensor for self-attention masking in the decoder
